questions.text: Which team won the first World Cup in 1930?
questions.explanation: Hosts Uruguay beat Argentina 4-2 in the final.

questions.text: Which country won the 1966 World Cup at home?
questions.explanation: England beat West Germany 4-2 after extra time at Wembley.

questions.text: Who scored the famous "Hand of God" goal?
questions.explanation: Maradona scored it with his hand against England in the quarter-final.

questions.text: How many teams played at the 1986 World Cup in Mexico?
questions.explanation: 1986 was the second World Cup with 24 teams.

questions.text: What was the score when Germany beat Brazil in the 2014 semi-final?
questions.explanation: Known as the "Mineirazo", one of the biggest shocks in World Cup history.

questions.text: Who won the 2022 World Cup final on penalties?
questions.explanation: Argentina won 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 draw.

questions.text: Who won the 2026 World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time at MetLife Stadium.

questions.text: Who is the all-time top scorer in World Cup history?
questions.explanation: Miroslav Klose scored 16 goals across four World Cups (2002-2014).

questions.text: Which was the first World Cup hosted by three countries?
questions.explanation: 2002 had two hosts; 2026 was the first with three.
